description: A simplified sample of validation and governance rules used to keep AI output constrained, auditable, and domain-correct.

principles.name: fail_closed
principles.description: If an output depends on controlled files, schemas, or catalogs and those controls cannot be loaded, do not freehand a polished answer.

principles.name: closed_schema_output
principles.description: Structured blocks may only contain approved fields in the approved order. Extra fields are treated as failure, not creativity.

principles.name: state_before_generation
principles.description: Read current session state, driver standing, and prior selections before generating a new assignment or scored result.

principles.name: human_context_is_data
principles.description: Driver self-report is treated as legitimate input alongside telemetry instead of being ignored as subjective noise.

forbidden_behavior: Do not print internal compatibility groups as user-facing fields.
sample_environment_block_schema.failure_behavior: Reject the generated block and regenerate through validator-controlled logic.

sample_ai_failure_modes_and_controls.failure_mode: AI invents a field that was not requested.
sample_ai_failure_modes_and_controls.control: Closed schema validation rejects outputs with extra keys.

sample_ai_failure_modes_and_controls.failure_mode: AI forgets whether a session is scored or observation-only.
sample_ai_failure_modes_and_controls.control: Evaluation Status and Session Integrity are explicit fields in intake and output.

sample_ai_failure_modes_and_controls.failure_mode: AI substitutes a car, track, or environment that was not in the project catalog.
sample_ai_failure_modes_and_controls.control: Selection must come from controlled atlas/catalog files.

sample_ai_failure_modes_and_controls.failure_mode: AI produces a long technical dump instead of coaching.
sample_ai_failure_modes_and_controls.control: Output contract requires coaching narrative and hides audit details unless requested.

sample_ai_failure_modes_and_controls.failure_mode: AI treats unreliable telemetry channels as authoritative.
sample_ai_failure_modes_and_controls.control: Telemetry trust exceptions mark which channels can and cannot be used for scoring.
